ideas.en: Can deep learning models classify IFC elements into their IFC classes using only the geometry of each object?
ideas.es: ¿Pueden los modelos de aprendizaje profundo clasificar elementos IFC en sus clases IFC usando solo la geometría de cada objeto?

ideas.en: IFC exchanges between software products lose information through reduction, simplification or interpretation, and elements can be mismapped to the wrong IFC entity through manual error or default templates.
ideas.es: Los intercambios IFC entre programas pierden información por reducción, simplificación o interpretación, y los elementos pueden asignarse a la entidad IFC equivocada por error manual o por plantillas predeterminadas.

ideas.en: Labelled datasets for BIM and IFC are scarce, which makes developing and verifying machine learning models difficult.
ideas.es: Los conjuntos de datos etiquetados para BIM e IFC son escasos, lo que dificulta desarrollar y verificar modelos de aprendizaje automático.

ideas.en: Earlier works assemble their own datasets and do not release them, which duplicates effort and makes comparison between methods impossible; IFCNet is meant as a common benchmark.
ideas.es: Los trabajos previos arman sus propios conjuntos de datos y no los publican, lo que duplica esfuerzo e impide comparar métodos; IFCNet busca ser un punto de comparación común.

ideas.en: Existing classification approaches are either rule-based (RANSAC, region growing, object and spatial rules, knowledge bases) or machine-learning-based (PointNet, MVCNN, 2D CNNs on images); Bloch & Sacks argue rule-based workflows do not apply to all problems.
ideas.es: Los enfoques existentes son basados en reglas (RANSAC, crecimiento de regiones, reglas de objetos y espaciales, bases de conocimiento) o de aprendizaje automático (PointNet, MVCNN, CNN 2D sobre imágenes); Bloch y Sacks argumentan que los flujos basados en reglas no sirven para todos los problemas.

ideas.en: IFCNet is a benchmark of single-entity IFC files that carry geometry and semantic information; it currently has 19,613 confirmed objects in 65 classes, mostly highly imbalanced.
ideas.es: IFCNet es un benchmark de archivos IFC de una sola entidad con geometría e información semántica; actualmente tiene 19,613 objetos confirmados en 65 clases, en su mayoría muy desbalanceadas.

ideas.en: IFCNetCore is the first sub-dataset of 20 classes selected for the experiments; it contains 7,930 objects with a training and test split.
ideas.es: IFCNetCore es el primer subconjunto de 20 clases elegido para los experimentos; contiene 7,930 objetos con una división de entrenamiento y prueba.

ideas.en: Around 1000 IFC models were collected from real-world projects, student works and online sources such as the University of Auckland repository, mostly authored in Autodesk Revit and ArchiCAD.
ideas.es: Se reunieron alrededor de 1000 modelos IFC de proyectos reales, trabajos de estudiantes y fuentes en línea como el repositorio de la Universidad de Auckland, creados sobre todo en Autodesk Revit y ArchiCAD.

ideas.en: The models were decomposed by extracting every object into its own file, together with its attached IfcPropertySets, focusing on subtypes of IfcDistributionElement, IfcBuildingElement and IfcFurnishingElement; this gave roughly 1.2M entities from 82 IFC classes in several representation types.
ideas.es: Los modelos se descompusieron extrayendo cada objeto a su propio archivo, junto con sus IfcPropertySets, enfocándose en subtipos de IfcDistributionElement, IfcBuildingElement e IfcFurnishingElement; esto dio aproximadamente 1.2M de entidades de 82 clases IFC en varios tipos de representación.

ideas.en: Deduplication normalizes each object's vertices to the unit sphere and uses them as a hash-map key, so identical geometry within a class is removed in linear time and the process can be parallelized.
ideas.es: La deduplicación normaliza los vértices de cada objeto a la esfera unitaria y los usa como llave de un mapa hash, de modo que la geometría idéntica dentro de una clase se elimina en tiempo lineal y el proceso se puede paralelizar.

ideas.en: Naive deduplication reduced the roughly 1.2M extracted entities to around 290k.
ideas.es: La deduplicación ingenua redujo las aproximadamente 1.2M de entidades extraídas a alrededor de 290k.

ideas.en: Entities were reviewed manually with a web-based tool that shows geometry and metadata and lets reviewers confirm or change the class; the labelling was carried out and supervised by domain experts.
ideas.es: Las entidades se revisaron manualmente con una herramienta web que muestra la geometría y los metadatos y permite confirmar o cambiar la clase; el etiquetado lo realizaron y supervisaron expertos del dominio.

ideas.en: Classes differ in difficulty: IfcFurniture has very large intra-class variance, while IfcWall and IfcPlate have small inter-class variance as both are plain rectangular shapes of varying thickness.
ideas.es: Las clases difieren en dificultad: IfcFurniture tiene una varianza intraclase muy grande, mientras que IfcWall e IfcPlate tienen poca varianza interclase porque ambas son formas rectangulares simples de espesor variable.

ideas.en: Models and elements of different Level of Information Need (LOIN) are included, which covers placeholder objects such as generic cubes that are likely classifiable only through their metadata.
ideas.es: Se incluyen modelos y elementos de distinto Nivel de Información Necesario (LOIN), lo que abarca objetos marcadores como cubos genéricos que probablemente solo se pueden clasificar por sus metadatos.

ideas.en: Most objects carry IfcProperties grouped in IfcPropertySets, mainly user-defined key-value pairs, often in different languages such as German, English, Dutch and French.
ideas.es: La mayoría de los objetos tienen IfcProperties agrupadas en IfcPropertySets, sobre todo pares llave-valor definidos por el usuario, a menudo en varios idiomas como alemán, inglés, neerlandés y francés.

ideas.en: All three experiments share one protocol: split train and test, hold out 30% of training data for validation to pick hyperparameters by balanced accuracy, retrain on the whole training set, and evaluate on the test set once.
ideas.es: Los tres experimentos comparten un protocolo: dividir en entrenamiento y prueba, apartar 30% del entrenamiento para validar y elegir hiperparámetros por exactitud balanceada, reentrenar con todo el entrenamiento y evaluar una sola vez en prueba.

ideas.en: MVCNN classifies each object from 12 rendered views taken by a camera rotating around the up-axis in 30° increments, and benefits from image networks pre-trained on large datasets like ImageNet.
ideas.es: MVCNN clasifica cada objeto a partir de 12 vistas renderizadas con una cámara que gira alrededor del eje vertical en incrementos de 30°, y aprovecha redes de imágenes preentrenadas en conjuntos grandes como ImageNet.

ideas.en: DGCNN works on point clouds of 2048 points sampled uniformly at random per object and normalized to the unit sphere, using convolutions over point neighborhoods to exploit local geometry.
ideas.es: DGCNN trabaja con nubes de 2048 puntos muestreados uniformemente al azar por objeto y normalizados a la esfera unitaria, usando convoluciones sobre vecindades de puntos para aprovechar la geometría local.

ideas.en: MeshNet uses the mesh directly, taking faces as the unit; meshes are simplified to a maximum of 2048 faces with Quadric Edge Collapse Decimation and turned into lists of faces with center, corners, normal and neighbors.
ideas.es: MeshNet usa la malla directamente, tomando las caras como unidad; las mallas se simplifican a un máximo de 2048 caras con Quadric Edge Collapse Decimation y se convierten en listas de caras con centro, esquinas, normal y vecinas.

ideas.en: MVCNN achieves the best overall results in balanced accuracy and F1 score among the three models, and it also beats DGCNN and MeshNet on low-count classes.
ideas.es: MVCNN logra los mejores resultados generales en exactitud balanceada y F1 entre los tres modelos, y también supera a DGCNN y MeshNet en clases con pocos objetos.

ideas.en: Classes with very few objects, such as IfcOutlet, show worse performance.
ideas.es: Las clases con muy pocos objetos, como IfcOutlet, muestran peor desempeño.

ideas.en: The three models make similar mistakes: plates, slabs and walls are among the most confused classes, and duct segments and pipe segments are also commonly confused.
ideas.es: Los tres modelos cometen errores parecidos: placas, losas y muros están entre las clases más confundidas, y los segmentos de ducto y de tubería también se confunden con frecuencia.

ideas.en: Using only geometry, all three models show reasonable performance and prove that they can learn from the dataset.
ideas.es: Usando solo geometría, los tres modelos muestran un desempeño razonable y demuestran que pueden aprender del conjunto de datos.

ideas.en: All three methods only use geometric information; combining geometry and semantic information in training was left out of scope.
ideas.es: Los tres métodos solo usan información geométrica; combinar geometría e información semántica durante el entrenamiento quedó fuera del alcance.

ideas.en: Normalizing the data before training discards absolute object size, and objects with few details can be very hard to classify out of the context of the full BIM model.
ideas.es: Normalizar los datos antes de entrenar descarta el tamaño absoluto de los objetos, y los objetos con pocos detalles pueden ser muy difíciles de clasificar fuera del contexto del modelo BIM completo.

ideas.en: Deduplication catches only identical geometry; objects that look alike but differ by vertex permutations or non-uniform scaling remain, and an exhaustive near-duplicate search is not feasible.
ideas.es: La deduplicación solo detecta geometría idéntica; los objetos parecidos que difieren por permutaciones de vértices o escalado no uniforme permanecen, y una búsqueda exhaustiva de casi duplicados no es factible.

ideas.en: Metadata mixes languages, has missing values, abbreviations and acronyms, and is sometimes inaccurate or wrong, so semantic properties need thorough pre-processing before use.
ideas.es: Los metadatos mezclan idiomas, tienen valores faltantes, abreviaturas y siglas, y a veces son inexactos o erróneos, por lo que las propiedades semánticas requieren un preprocesamiento minucioso antes de usarse.

ideas.en: Not all objects listed after deduplication have been reviewed and confirmed yet, and labelling needs domain knowledge, making the dataset more resource intensive than other machine learning datasets.
ideas.es: No todos los objetos listados tras la deduplicación se han revisado y confirmado, y el etiquetado exige conocimiento del dominio, lo que hace al conjunto más costoso que otros de aprendizaje automático.

ideas.en: Future work: expand IFCNet with more objects, classes and semantic information toward a large-scale dataset for BIM and IFC, and develop models that use properties and semantic information.
ideas.es: Trabajo futuro: ampliar IFCNet con más objetos, clases e información semántica hacia un conjunto a gran escala para BIM e IFC, y desarrollar modelos que usen propiedades e información semántica.

ideas.en: With sufficient size, IFCNet could be used for pre-training on 3D data, as large image datasets are used in 2D; transfer learning for 3D data is an active research area.
ideas.es: Con el tamaño suficiente, IFCNet podría servir para preentrenar con datos 3D, como los grandes conjuntos de imágenes se usan en 2D; el aprendizaje por transferencia en 3D es un área de investigación activa.

ideas.en: The classifier could be integrated into the BIM workflow like SEEBIM: on importing an IFC file the network infers element classes, and the author sees the potential misclassifications and accepts or rejects each proposal.
ideas.es: El clasificador podría integrarse al flujo BIM como SEEBIM: al importar un archivo IFC la red infiere las clases de los elementos, y el autor ve las posibles clasificaciones erróneas y acepta o rechaza cada propuesta.

edges.why: The scarcity of labelled BIM data is the reason IFCNet was built.
The lack of shared public datasets motivates a common benchmark.
Mismapped or inconsistent classes are the interoperability problem that classification is meant to address.
Rule-based methods do not fit all cases, which motivates trying deep learning.
The collected models are the raw source of the dataset.
Decomposition is applied to the collected models.
Deduplication runs on the extracted entities.
The reduction from 1.2M to around 290k shows what deduplication removed.
Manual review follows deduplication.
IFCNetCore is the 20-class subset of the full dataset.
Class difficulty and imbalance are why a balanced 20-class subset is used and what it still contains.
Placeholder objects of varying LOIN add to the difficulty of the classes.
Property sets are extracted and attached to each entity.
The protocol splits and trains on IFCNetCore.
MVCNN follows the shared protocol.
DGCNN follows the shared protocol.
MeshNet follows the shared protocol.
MVCNN gets the best overall results.
The confused pairs match the small inter-class variance described.
Poor results on rare classes follow from the class imbalance.
Reasonable performance from geometry alone answers the question affirmatively.
Lost size and lost context help explain why similar-looking classes are confused.
The geometry-only scope leads to the call for models that use semantics.
Noisy metadata is a reason semantics were not used.
MVCNN already benefits from pre-training on image datasets, which suggests the 3D analogue.
Near-duplicates survive the exact-vertex deduplication.
Useful but imperfect predictions suit a workflow where the author accepts or rejects.

thesis.why: Takes whole IFC models apart into individual entity files with their property sets to get training examples, but drops relations between elements.
Decomposes models into elements only; the relations half of the hypothesis is lost since each file holds a single entity, a gap to fill.
Shows a concrete cleaning step for real models: hash-based deduplication that cut 1.2M to around 290k.
Adds expert manual review with a dedicated tool, since automatic steps and authoring defaults leave misclassified elements.
Shows the limit of exact deduplication: near-duplicates remain and cannot be found exhaustively.
A dataset built as a benchmark for classification and semantic enrichment, not for generation.
Includes elements of different Level of Information Need on purpose, so placeholders are classifiable only by metadata.
Draws its size from real projects, student works and online repositories, and its quality from heavy filtering and labelling.
Proposes a workflow where the network proposes classes and the author accepts or rejects each, a signal that could be logged.
Contrasts rule-based classification with learned classification and cites arguments that rules do not cover all cases.
Documents how IFC exchange loses information and mismaps elements, which affects any pipeline that reads real IFC files.
Real metadata is multilingual, incomplete and sometimes wrong, so it needs pre-processing before a model can learn from it.
